Built for

Web hosts. Every hosting plan you sell needs a domain. Sell that too.

Hosting is a volume business: attach rates, renewals, and margin decide who wins. Your customers already buy hosting from you. When their domain, email, or SSL comes from somewhere else, you lose margin and hand part of the relationship away.

500+ TLDs to sell

Every extension your customers ask for, from .com to the newest gTLDs, at wholesale prices.

Plugs into your billing

WHMCS, AWBS, and Blesta integrations connect domains to the billing you already run.

Pricing that drops as you grow

Domain pricing is slab-based and published. The more domain business you do with us, the lower your buy price. No negotiation to see your rate.

Add-ons your customers already want

Sell email and productivity with Titan and Google Workspace, SSL certificates, and security add-ons on your own website through the API, right next to your hosting.

White-label end to end

Your customers see your brand in the storefront and the panel. Your customers stay yours.

Margin on every renewal

Buy at wholesale, set your own retail price. Domains renew every year, and the margin repeats with them.

Agency work runs on speed and simplicity: ship the project, bill the client, move on. A client project needs more than a domain, and ResellerClub carries the full suite: hosting of every type, email, SSL, and the domain it all starts with, under your brand.

The full product suite

Domains, shared to dedicated hosting, email with Titan and Google Workspace, and SSL, all wholesale, all on one account.

The WebPro panel

Run every client from one panel: domains, hosting, email, and SSL grouped by customer, with bulk actions for the day-to-day.

Provision fast

Set up a client's domain, email, and SSL in minutes, then get back to the project.

Fits your tools

WHMCS, AWBS, Blesta, and Plesk integrations connect the suite to the billing and provisioning you already use.

Bring your book of business

Hands-on migration and onboarding support moves existing client domains and services over without a scramble.

Bill your way

You set retail prices and invoice clients under your own brand. The margin is yours.

The platform behind you

A stable, proven platform behind you.

Your business runs on OrderBox, the registrar platform behind ResellerClub. It carries the infrastructure and the compliance, so what your customers see is simply you.

The registrar backbone, run for you

Registrations, transfers, renewals, DNS, and registry connections all run on OrderBox. You operate a domain business without operating registrar infrastructure.

Proven at registrar scale

The same infrastructure that runs ICANN-accredited registrars runs your reseller business, so the platform under your customers holds up as you grow.

Compliance handled for you

ICANN and registry compliance is managed on the platform, so you sell domains without carrying registrar accreditation or the rules that come with it.
